text:
maya: Heads-up — proposing a staged rollout for model_v2 in EU next week. Goal: validate latency + QA on real tenant traffic before wide release. Need agreement on canary slices, A/B metrics, and fallback policy.

devin: +1. Thinking micro-canary (5%) -> 20% -> 100% over 48h windows with automatic safety checks. Per-tenant opt-out for top 10 customers.

sam: @devin what safety checks do you want? p95 latency, 5xx rate? Also need cost/backpressure thresholds for dedicated pools.

devin: Primary checks: p95 <= 450ms (steady traffic), error-rate (5xx + timeout) < 1.0%. Secondary: embedding/regression checks — false-positive hallucination alarms from evals. If any primary breaches for 10m, immediate rollback to model_v1 in-region.

liz: QA will run the smoke eval set during each window — adding failure modes: tokenization diff, structured output mismatch. We need a gating signal from the eval runner before each percentage jump.

alejandra: Sales note — two EU enterprise customers asked for early access. Can we allocate them to a 20% cohort if they opt in? They require a rollback SLA and a contact in support.

maya: Yes — plan: cohort assignment order = internal-only (1) -> opt-in customers (2) -> 5% random (3) -> 20% -> 100%. Opt-in customers get a dedicated contact and a 2h hotfix SLA during their window.

sam: Ops ask: add a circuit-breaker that drops traffic to model_v2 if GPU mem pressure > 85% for 5m or queue length > 200. Also add a forced degrade route to model_v1_kvcached for latency-sensitive endpoints.

devin: Agree. Proposed feature flag snippet — can someone vet?

```
flag: model_v2_eu
rollout:
  mode: phased
  cohorts: [internal, opt-in, 5%, 20%, 100%]
metrics:
  primary: [p95_latency_ms, error_rate_5xx, timeout_rate]
  secondary: [eval_fail_rate, embedding_drift_score]
fallback: model_v1_eu
degrade_route: model_v1_kvcached
kill_conditions:
  - p95_latency_ms > 450 for 10m
  - error_rate_5xx > 1.0% for 10m
  - gpu_mem_util > 85% for 5m
```

maya: @liz can QA script the eval runner to block rollout until the smoke set passes in the opt-in + 5% windows? If fail, it should post to this thread and trigger rollback.

liz: Yep. I’ll add a CI/CD job that runs the smoke eval on a mirror of live traffic. It will post a summary JSON and set a boolean gate.

alejandra: For the two enterprises: please confirm they are excluded from the random 5% cohort unless they explicitly opt-in. Also include a one-click rollback contact in the portal.

devin: We'll add tenant-scoped flags so opt-in is explicit. Also adding audit logs for who flipped what and when.

rollout-bot: Scheduled job created: /rollout prepare --flag model_v2_eu --date 2024-06-12T09:00Z --checklist [ops,qa,telemetry]

sam: Runbook snippet for oncall:
- If any kill_condition fires: `/rollout abort --flag model_v2_eu --reason "safety-trigger"`
- Fallback: automatic traffic-shift to `model_v1_eu` and notify #eng-oncall + product oncall
- If degrade route needed: `/route set --service latency-sensitive --model model_v1_kvcached`

maya: Launch criteria checklist (must all be green before 20% move):
- Internal 24h stability (no primary breaches)
- Smoke eval pass at 5% and opt-in cohort
- Telemetry dashboard shows p95 and error within thresholds for 60m post-change
- Support readiness and customer contacts assigned

devin: Timeline: dry-run wed, internal canary thurs (24h), opt-in friday (48h), 5% saturday (24h), 20% sunday if all green. Contingency: abort at any step.

liz: I'll attach the smoke eval job id when ready and post results here.

alejandra: I'll confirm the two customers and gather their legal/ops contacts.

maya: Great — if no objections, I'll lock the flag config and schedule the dry-run. People: please react with :thumbsup: if you approve.

devin: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

liz: :thumbsup:

alejandra: :thumbsup:

maya: (locking plan) — scheduling now. Will ping when the dry-run job is up and add a short recap to the playbook.
